title: Traditional Ukranian Borscht
description: A hearty beet-based soup originating from Ukraine, typically served with a dollop of sour cream. This recipe combines classic ingredients with a hint of fish for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add grated beets, carrots, and cabbage. Cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add fish broth, tomato paste (if using), and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with a dollop of sour cream and garnished with chopped fresh dill.
